title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Leave-Behind for a Completed Batch Awaiting Finalization
content:
**Cartwise Shopper Payouts — shopper standing schedule for the catch-up deposit**

What a catch-up deposit leaves behind on the balance for the batch that is completed but not yet finalized depends on the shopper's standing. The amount left behind stays on the Cartwise Shopper Payouts balance and is not part of the catch-up deposit.

## Schedule

| Shopper level (Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts) | Batch base-pay entries in the last 3 months (Cartwise Shopper Batches) | Left behind for that batch |
|---|---|---|
| Full-Service Shopper Gold or above | 24 or more | Only the tips posted on that batch |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 12 or more | Those tips plus half of the batch's other credits, the sum rounded to the cent |
| Any other combination | — | Every credit of that batch |

The clause the schedule restates: a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Gold level or above with 24 or more batch base-pay entries in the last 3 months leaves behind only the tips posted on that batch; a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Silver level with 12 or more batch base-pay entries in the last 3 months leaves behind those tips plus half of the batch's other credits, the sum rounded to the cent; any other shopper leaves behind every credit of that batch.

## Definitions

- **The batch** is the shopper's batch on Cartwise Shopper Batches whose status is completed and which is not yet finalized.
- **Every credit of that batch** is the total of the earnings credits booked on the payout account from that batch.
- **The tips posted on that batch** are the tip entries posted on that batch in Cartwise Shopper Batches, added together.
- **The batch's other credits** are every credit of that batch less those tips. In the Silver row, half of the other credits is added to the tips and that sum is rounded to the cent once.
- **Batch base-pay entries** are the pay entries of the base-pay component posted on Cartwise Shopper Batches. "The last 3 months" counts the entries booked fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the catch-up.
- **Shopper level** is the level on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record. Shopper levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond, and a level named with "or above" is read in that order; Gold or above therefore means Gold, Platinum or Diamond.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Level | Base-pay entries, last 3 months | Row that governs |
|---|---|---|
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 24 | Only the tips |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 23 | Every credit |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 20 | Every credit (the Silver row names the Silver level only) |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 12 | Tips plus half of the other credits |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 11 | Every credit |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 30 | Tips plus half of the other credits |
| Full-Service Shopper | 40 | Every credit |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

A completed batch not yet finalized has credits of 60.00 on the payout account, of which tips posted on the batch are 14.00, leaving other credits of 46.00. A Gold-or-above shopper with enough base-pay entries leaves behind 14.00. A qualifying Silver shopper leaves behind 14.00 plus half of 46.00, which is 37.00. Any other shopper leaves behind the whole 60.00.
